kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نفتقر (form VIII)
# نَفْتَقِرُ (naftaqiru) /naf.ta.qi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
# نَفْتَقِرَ (naftaqira) /naf.ta.qi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
# نَفْتَقِرْ (naftaqir) /naf.ta.qir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
